summary: You have produced an outstanding, professionally presented mission design for ZYZZsat. Your technical analyses, hand calculations, and STK integrations are rigorous, and your clear justification of mission requirements and critical evaluation of design constraints demonstrate exemplary engineering maturity. Excellent work across all report sections.
next_steps: In Section 2.2, refine the launch azimuth analysis by correcting the inertial azimuth for Earth's tangential surface velocity to determine the vehicle's true burnout heading.
Develop the technology readiness level (TRL) discussions in Section 3 into a concrete risk-mitigation timeline for the optical payload and launch options.
Carry forward this exemplary practice of dual-verifying numerical derivations against software simulations in your future aerospace engineering projects.

criteria.C1: You did an excellent job in Section 1 establishing the operational need for monitoring Great Barrier Reef coral bleaching. You clearly justified the single-satellite architecture over constellations and accurately mapped Australian end-users with strong literature backing. To maintain this Accomplished standard, continue integrating specific stakeholder operational requirements directly into your mission objectives.
criteria.C2: Your mission design in Section 2 is comprehensive, featuring exceptional alignment between your analytical orbital calculations and STK simulations. To refine your calculations to professional fidelity, adjust the launch azimuth equation in Section 2.2 to account for Earth's tangential surface velocity, which differentiates the inertial trajectory from the vehicle's actual burnout heading.
criteria.C3: In Section 3, you provided a mature synthesis of mission outcomes and effectively identified four genuine technical limitations, including launcher readiness and revisit intervals. To sustain this top-tier Accomplished level, ensure future work recommendations outline concrete engineering mitigation pathways and verification milestones for each identified limitation.
criteria.C4: Your presentation was flawless throughout, featuring a concise Executive Summary, cleanly formatted tables, and well-integrated STK figures. Your consistent report structure and accurate IEEE referencing make the document easy to follow. To maintain this standard, continue ensuring all technical figures and tables are explicitly discussed in the main narrative.
